data.title: Tea in the staff room

memoryNodes.cue: People describe the team’s confidence and energy.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 大家描述团队的信心和精神状态。

memoryNodes.cue: Lin and Jo talk about what helps them keep going.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林和乔讨论什么能帮助她们坚持。

memoryNodes.cue: The centre wants experienced people to stay.

data.situation:
At the end of the day, Lin carried the empty cups into the staff room. The room was small, with a kettle beside the window and a noticeboard above the table. Jo was reading comments from the team. Several people liked the work but said the last-minute changes were wearing down morale. They wanted a plan that helped the centre retain experienced people. Lin: What gives you motivation on a difficult day?
Jo: Knowing that a visitor left with an answer. A thank-you from the team can boost motivation too.
Lin: Could we have a short meeting where both desks share useful ideas?
Jo: That might help build team spirit. Free entry to some events is a nice perk, but it does not replace a rota people can rely on. Team suggestions
Publish the rota earlier.
Make time to share good ideas from both desks.
Ask staff which changes would help them stay.
Discuss staff retention at the next meeting.

readingBlocks.en: At the end of the day, Lin carried the empty cups into the staff room. The room was small, with a kettle beside the window and a noticeboard above the table. Jo was reading comments from the team. Several people liked the work but said the last-minute changes were wearing down morale. They wanted a plan that helped the centre retain experienced people.
readingBlocks.zh: 一天结束时，林把空杯子拿进休息室。房间不大，窗边有水壶，桌上方有告示板。乔在读团队的意见。几个人喜欢这份工作，但说临时变化在消磨士气。他们希望有一个能帮助中心留住熟手的计划。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: What gives you motivation on a difficult day?
Jo: Knowing that a visitor left with an answer. A thank-you from the team can boost motivation too.
Lin: Could we have a short meeting where both desks share useful ideas?
Jo: That might help build team spirit. Free entry to some events is a nice perk, but it does not replace a rota people can rely on.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：难熬的一天里，什么给你动力？
乔：知道访客带着答案离开了。团队的一声谢谢也能鼓舞动力。
林：能否开个短会，让两个前台分享有用的点子？
乔：那也许有助于建立团队精神。有些活动可以免费入场，是个不错的额外福利，但不能代替可靠的排班表。

readingBlocks.en:
Team suggestions
Publish the rota earlier.
Make time to share good ideas from both desks.
Ask staff which changes would help them stay.
Discuss staff retention at the next meeting.
readingBlocks.zh:
团队建议
更早公布排班表。
留时间分享两个前台的好点子。
询问哪些变化能帮助工作人员留任。
在下次会面讨论员工留任。

glossary.zh: 团队的信心与精神状态；士气
glossary.example: Last-minute changes are wearing down morale.

externalEvidence.definition: the spirit of a group that makes the members want the group to succeed

glossary.zh: 促使人行动或继续努力的动力
glossary.note: motivation to do something；这里为行动动力。
glossary.example: Helping a visitor gives Jo motivation.
glossary.exampleZh: 帮助访客给乔带来动力。

externalEvidence.definition: the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior

glossary.zh: 培养团队的团结与合作精神
glossary.note: build team spirit；这是希望达到的效果。
glossary.example: Sharing useful ideas might help build team spirit.
glossary.exampleZh: 分享有用的点子也许能培养团队精神。

glossary.zh: 工作带来的额外福利或便利
glossary.note: 可数，a perk/perks；通常口语中使用。
glossary.example: Free entry to some events is a perk of the job.
glossary.exampleZh: 某些活动免费入场是这份工作的额外福利。

externalEvidence.definition: an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)

glossary.note: retain staff；这里是使人继续留在组织中。
glossary.example: The centre wants to retain experienced staff.
glossary.exampleZh: 中心想留住有经验的工作人员。

externalEvidence.definition: allow to remain in a place or position or maintain a property or feature

glossary.zh: 持续保有或留住的过程
glossary.note: 不可数，staff retention；与retain的动词用法区分。
glossary.example: The team will discuss staff retention.
